item.title: Army drops roses on Syrian crowds in a far cry from war

item.description: Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya to meet Egyptian intelligence chief Hassan Rashad in Cairo amid ongoing Gaza tensions.

item.description: Yemen's Ministry of Information denounces attacks on Marib as 'escalation' that threatens lives and increases suffering.

item.title: At least five reported dead amid flooding in US state of Indiana
item.description: Indiana's state governor says that US government has promised assistance after a week of heavy rainfall.

item.title: US Democrats finalise major shakeup to 2028 presidential primary calendar
item.description: South Carolina will again take centre stage as the first nominating contest, pushing Iowa from its top spot.

item.title: Why is the latest Ebola outbreak worsening?
item.description: Virus spreading in DRC faster than containment efforts.

item.title: Qatar denies Tehran’s claim it is detaining Iranian bomber pilots

item.title: California tackles multiple wildfires as firefighter workforce faces strain
item.description: The federal wildland firefighting workforce, faced with low pay and cost of living issues, copes with Trump-era cuts.

item.description: The petition is set to be discussed by House of Commons in a sign of discontent with policies of US President Trump.

item.description: A social media campaign encouraged people to flock to Ceuta just weeks after many died while making the crossing.

item.title: Death toll from Zimbabwe ferry disaster rises to 72

item.title: Cleanup underway as Russian oil spill reaches Oman’s coastline
item.description: Cleanup crews are responding along 12 kilometres of Omani coastline following an oil spill from the grounded tanker.

item.description: Authorities warn residents to take precautions as storm is expected to bring rain and strong winds to the island chain.

item.title: UK PM Burnham reacts to death of former Cambridge professor

item.title: Erdogan says Egypt could join Turkiye-Saudi-Pakistan defence pact
item.description: Turkish president tells Al Jazeera that the recently signed agreement is open to new members as he pledges continued support.

item.title: One killed, dozens injured after wildfire hits Croatian coast

item.title: Sudan’s al-Burhan pledges immunity for dialogue, rules out Hemedti return
